notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, act May 15, 1922, ch. 190, § 3, 42 Stat. 542, which related to mortgages on farm lands under United States reclamation projects, and contained a definition of “first mortgage” as used in section 771 of this title, was omitted because of the repeal of section 771 and other sections of this title that were based on the Federal Farm Loan Act.
